title: Cognitive Complaints in Survivors of Breast Cancer After Chemotherapy Compared With Age-Matched Controls: An Analysis From a Nationwide Multicenter Prospective Longitudinal Study
notes: URCC NCORP study. N=581 (chemo) + N=364 controls. Longitudinal. FACT-Cog. Chemo patients had worse cognitive complaints pre-treatment and up to 6mo. TNF-α, IL-6 associated.
